description: Builds the webapp's static CSS (Tailwind + daisyUI) and vendors fflate and the Geist fonts (OFL) into backend/tagged/web. Run after changing classes in index.html/app.js.

scripts.build: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i input.css -o ../backend/tagged/web/app.css --minify && cp node_modules/fflate/umd/index.js ../backend/tagged/web/fflate.js && cp node_modules/geist/dist/fonts/geist-sans/Geist-Variable.woff2 ../backend/tagged/web/geist.woff2 && cp node_modules/geist/dist/fonts/geist-mono/GeistMono-Variable.woff2 ../backend/tagged/web/geist-mono.woff2
